highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152 previews Graphite GPU rendering and asynchronous pixel readback on the Skia m152 engine.
highlights_body: The preview also expands Vulkan integration options and enables font support on Nano Server. Native-backed views now retain their owners correctly, closing several use-after-free and failure-path leak risks.

bullets.detail: Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and includes the latest upstream stability fixes from the preceding m151 line.
Adds the next-generation Graphite backend for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, providing managed access to Skia's newer GPU architecture.
SKImage and SKSurface can request pixel reads without blocking through a backend-neutral API.
SKRegion span iterators and SKPixmap subsets now keep their source objects alive, preventing use-after-free failures.
SKImage.Create now releases its unmanaged pixel buffer when raster image creation fails.

bullets.lead: Managed hot paths allocate and copy less
bullets.detail: SKData.SaveTo avoids a duplicate buffer copy, while encoded-text and runtime-effect uniform lookups reduce recurring managed overhead.
Uses FreeType so text rendering can resolve fonts on Windows Nano Server.
Adds SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET as a supported bridge for applications using Silk.NET's Vulkan bindings.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Enabled FreeType-based font support on Windows Nano Server
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp received broader platform validation, including Alpine/musl and Nano Server coverage, alongside project-format modernization.

v4.152.0-preview.1.1.subtitle: Introduces the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and Skia milestone 152.
v4.152.0-preview.1.1.website_summary: Preview 1 introduces Graphite, async pixel readback, Nano Server font support, and Skia milestone 152.

bullets.text: Added Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn
Added backend-neutral async pixel readback for SKImage and SKSurface
Added a Silk.NET Vulkan integration package
Enabled FreeType-based font support on Nano Server
Updated the bundled Skia engine to milestone 152
Kept SKRegion span iterators and SKPixmap subsets rooted to their native owners
Released unmanaged pixel buffers when raster image creation fails
